newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-W.Australia calls tender for power station.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-W.Australia calls tender for power station.

text.p: Western Australian government-owned Western Power Corporation on Tuesday called for expressions of interest to manage and operate its new A$575 million Collie power station.
Interested parties will have until March 7 to contact Western Power after which the corporation will ask a short-list of prospective operators to submit competitive bids.

State Resources Minister Colin Barnett said on Monday the 300 megawatt power station, due for commissioning late in 1998, will be the first state-owned power station in Western Australia to be privately managed.
"Western Power assessed all available options," Barnett said after cabinet endorsed the corporation's decision.
"A privately-operated Collie power station will bring financial savings to Western Power and provide exciting opportunities for regional and local employment in the South-West," the premier said.
He said the arrangement would also help Western Power hold down its costs and prices.
